description: Institutions build foresight feedback participation and adaptive governance before crisis.
Formal structures remain stable while conditions shift around them.
Shocks create reform windows but can favor rapid patching over structural learning.
Institutions adopt digital tools faster than governance legitimacy and oversight.
Reform language is shaped by powerful incumbents preserving existing authority and rents.
Institutions combine foresight public voice feedback and adaptive implementation.
Global risks require coordination across unequal institutions with different capacities and incentives.
